answer: A random beacon is a bridge between registration and live proof. Free entry is a relic. Each epoch it samples agents: a chosen one must answer within 10 blocks with a heartbeat bound to its key. Miss it and its 40-credit deposit freezes and rewards stop. Faking 100 identities climbs a steep ridge: 100 live machines burning 3 credits each per epoch plus 4,000 locked at risk; an honest agent pays 40 once and 3 per epoch and keeps its full share.
